tiers.name: Platform
tiers.blurb: Where it has been proven to run.

tiers.name: Portfolio
tiers.blurb: What you have shipped over time.

achievements.name: Tinker
achievements.description: You reached past the browser sandbox and touched real hardware.
achievements.criteria: App uses WebUSB, Web Serial or Web Bluetooth.

achievements.name: Visualizer
achievements.description: Pixels pushed straight to the GPU.
achievements.criteria: App acquires a WebGL or WebGL2 rendering context.

achievements.name: Maestro
achievements.description: Note on, note off.
achievements.criteria: App requests MIDI access via the Web MIDI API.

achievements.name: Sixth Sense
achievements.description: Your app knows which way is up.
achievements.criteria: App reads DeviceOrientation, Accelerometer or Gyroscope data.

achievements.name: Rumbler
achievements.description: Controllers in, feedback out.
achievements.criteria: App uses WebHID or the Gamepad API.

achievements.name: Sound Engineer
achievements.description: Not just playback — an actual signal chain.
achievements.criteria: App builds a Web Audio graph (AudioContext with two or more connected nodes).

achievements.name: Oracle
achievements.description: Inference without a server in sight.
achievements.criteria: App runs on-device inference via WebNN, WebGPU compute or a bundled model runtime.

achievements.name: Tap
achievements.description: Close-range and contactless.
achievements.criteria: App uses the Web NFC API.

achievements.name: Operator
achievements.description: You wired two machines together.
achievements.criteria: App uses WebRTC or WebSocket peer connectivity.

achievements.name: Full Stack Tinkerer
achievements.description: Every peripheral bus, one app. Show-off.
achievements.criteria: A single app uses WebUSB, Web Serial, Web Bluetooth and WebHID.

achievements.name: Off the Grid
achievements.description: Nothing leaves the device. Provably.
achievements.criteria: No fetch, XHR, WebSocket, beacon or remote asset reference anywhere in the bundle.

achievements.name: Purist
achievements.description: No framework, no bundler, no excuses.
achievements.criteria: Bundle contains no third-party libraries or vendored dependencies.

achievements.name: Featherweight
achievements.description: Loads before you finish reading the title.
achievements.criteria: Total package size under 256 KB.

achievements.name: Sizecoder
achievements.description: Every byte earned its place.
achievements.criteria: Total package size under 64 KB.

achievements.name: 4K
achievements.description: The old ways still work.
achievements.criteria: Total package size under 4 KB.

achievements.name: Clean Bill
achievements.description: Through the scanner first time, no notes.
achievements.criteria: Verdict GOOD on the first scan, with no resubmission.

achievements.name: Showreel
achievements.description: You showed it running instead of describing it.
achievements.criteria: A valid YouTube demo URL is attached to the submission.

achievements.name: Well Documented
achievements.description: Someone can figure out what this does without running it.
achievements.criteria: Icon, at least two screenshots, a description over 300 characters, tags and a licence.

achievements.name: Progressive
achievements.description: Denied a permission and carried on regardless.
achievements.criteria: Every gated API call sits behind a guard or catch with a working fallback path.

achievements.name: Homebrewer
achievements.description: Verified running on real Switch hardware.
achievements.criteria: App confirmed working under the Brewser runtime on Tegra X1.

achievements.name: Dual Native
achievements.description: One codebase, two very different machines.
achievements.criteria: Identical bundle verified working in both Chrome and Brewser, no platform branches.

achievements.name: Conformist
achievements.description: Plays strictly by the spec.
achievements.criteria: App passes the gl-probes regression suite with no fallbacks triggered.

achievements.name: Sixty
achievements.description: Locked frame rate on modest silicon.
achievements.criteria: Sustains 60fps on Tegra X1 across a full telemetry session.

achievements.name: Publisher
achievements.description: You shipped something. That is the hard part.
achievements.criteria: Published apps that scanned GOOD and have a complete manifest.

achievements.name: Polymath
achievements.description: You refuse to stay in one lane.
achievements.criteria: Published apps spanning four or more distinct catalogue categories.

achievements.name: Collector
achievements.description: Working your way through the platform surface.
achievements.criteria: Eight or more distinct Web APIs used across your published portfolio.

achievements.name: Iterator
achievements.description: Shipping once is easy. Coming back is not.
achievements.criteria: Ten accepted updates to a single app.

achievements.name: Steady Hand
achievements.description: Consistency beats bursts.
achievements.criteria: At least one accepted submission or update in six consecutive calendar months.

achievements.name: Wish Granter
achievements.description: Someone asked. You built it.
achievements.criteria: Published an app linked to an Ideas Board entry authored by another publisher.

achievements.name: Muse
achievements.description: Your idea became someone elses app.
achievements.criteria: An idea you submitted is referenced by another publishers linked_app_ids.

achievements.name: Greetz
achievements.description: Credit where it is due.
achievements.criteria: Credited another Brewser publisher in a published app manifest.

achievements.name: Mentor
achievements.description: You spend as much time helping as building.
achievements.criteria: Twenty-five or more comments on other publishers apps or ideas.

achievements.name: Signal
achievements.description: You named something the community wanted.
achievements.criteria: An idea you submitted passed fifty upvotes.

achievements.name: Founder
achievements.description: Here before the catalogue had anything in it.
achievements.criteria: Among the first one hundred accounts to publish an app. Permanently closed once reached.

achievements.name: Played
achievements.description: People are actually running this.
achievements.criteria: Distinct play sessions recorded for a single app.

achievements.name: Scorekeeper
achievements.description: There is a number to beat.
achievements.criteria: App integrates the Brewser leaderboard SDK and has recorded submissions.

achievements.name: Persistent
achievements.description: Progress survives a power cycle.
achievements.criteria: App integrates the Brewser save SDK and has recorded writes.

achievements.name: Rock Solid
achievements.description: A thousand sessions, not one crash.
achievements.criteria: One thousand play sessions with zero crash telemetry on the current version.
